sentences.en: There is no denying the fact that smoking is harmful.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，吸烟是有害的。

sentences.en: A long spell of rainy weather is harmful to plants.
sentences.zh: 长时间的阴雨天气对植物有害。

sentences.en: Insecticides are agricultural chemicals that exterminate insects harmful to plants.
sentences.zh: 杀虫剂是用于消灭危害植物的昆虫的农业化学制品。

senses.zh: 对…有害的,能造成损害的,不利,不良

mnemonic: 词根记忆：harm（伤害）+ful（…的）→有害的
